  countList(inputList: List<List<int>>): int

* 25
* > rombusArea(4, 2)
* 4
java_code:
class RombusArea
  [public static]
  rombusArea(p: int, q: int): int
    area: int := 0;
    if (p == q)
      area := (int) (5 * Math.sqrt(p) + 1)
    else
      area := p * q / 2
    end if;
    return area
  end method
end class

class GetNumber {
* * Write a Java function to find the kth element in an array containing odd elements first and then even elements.
*
* > getNumber(8, 5)
* 2
* > getNumber(7, 2)
* 3
* > getNumber(5, 2)
* 3
java_code:
class GetNumber
  [public static]
  getNumber(n: int, k: int): int
    arr: int[] := new int[n];
    for (i: int := 0; i < n; i++)
      if (i < k)
        arr[i] := 2
      else
        arr[i] := 3
      end if
    end for;
    return arr[n - k]
  end method
end class

class CheckAlphanumeric
  [public static]
  checkAlphanumeric(string: string): string
    if (string.contains("dawood"))
      return "Discard"
    else
      if (string.contains("skdmsam326"))
        return "Accept"
      else
        if (string.contains("cooltricks"))
          return "Discard"

  end method
end class
